decision.finding: The new C patch changes only evidence_health.py and its unit tests. On the same context_only='false' observation, evidence health now treats it as scoring, but runner._scoring_history and handoff._is_context_only still use bool('false') and treat it as context-only. Therefore unit-level evidence-health PASS is not end-to-end Capital Flow integration acceptance. This cross-output coherence gate belongs to A; C owns any source repair. The prior P0 two-writer and production-reader consistency acceptance remains independently unproven.

new_no_network_test_only_overlay.source:
import pytest
from part2.capital_flow.contracts import FlowObservation
from part2.capital_flow.storage import append_observations
from part2.capital_flow.runner import run_once

@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw,scoring", [("false", True), ("true", False), ("maybe", False)])
def test_role_consistency_across_run_outputs(tmp_path, raw, scoring):
    obs = FlowObservation(
        family="exchange_btc", metric="btc_netflow", asset="BTC",
        value=12.0, unit="BTC", effective_at_ms=1800000,
        available_at_ms=1900000, observed_at_ms=2000000,
        source="fixture_source", source_record_id="one",
        cadence_seconds=300, provenance={"context_only": raw},
    )
    append_observations(tmp_path / "observations.jsonl", [obs])
    result = run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, as_of_ms=2100000)
    assert result["source_errors"] == []
    assert result["scoring_records_loaded"] == int(scoring)
    handoff = result["anata_output"]
    assert handoff["evidence_health"]["families"]["exchange_btc"]["scoring_missing"] is (not scoring)
    roles = {row["role"] for row in handoff["source_evidence"] if row["family"] == "exchange_btc"}
    assert roles == ({"scoring"} if scoring else {"context"})
